name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=ui): name reflects data type (table/array), domain (ui), and purpose (chapter-intro dialog corner offsets). The '_a' suffix is NOT a Ghidra address residue (address 0x526DA's residue would be _526da/_6da); it is a meaningful pair disambiguator distinguishing this from the adjacent twin data_fd2_ui_chapter_intro_dialog_corner_offset_table_b @ 0x526EA, which holds the identical four offsets for a different reader. The 'chapter_intro' descriptor is actually more correct than the reader function's own name, whose 'tutorial' token its own plate documents as a misnomer.
purpose: Speech-bubble 'wing' corner offsets for the chapter-intro dialog panel open/close animation: 4 signed int32 { -39, -13, 13, 39 } placed symmetrically around the panel center.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_animate_tutorial_dialog_intro_or_outro (@ 0x2D669) copies all four dwords into a local corner_offs[16] buffer via a count-4 REP MOVSD, then per animation frame computes each wing's blit destination as base + corner_offs[i] / divisor + 0xD430. The element is loaded as a signed dword and divided with IDIV (SAR EDX,0x1F sign-extend then IDIV). The symmetric -39/-13/13/39 pairs place the four wings around the panel center; divisor ramps 1..4 (open) or 4..1 (close) to slide the wings in/out.
element_semantics: Each element is a signed 32-bit corner offset (pixel/byte displacement into the 320-wide framebuffer-style work buffer) for one of the four dialog-panel wings; values { -39, -13, 13, 39 } form two symmetric pairs about the panel center. At blit time the element is divided by the per-frame divisor (1..4) so larger divisor pulls the wing closer to center.
notes: Memory at 0x526DA = d9 ff ff ff f3 ff ff ff 0d 00 00 00 27 00 00 00 = {-39,-13,13,39}; Ghidra DataType already dword[4] len=16. Only 2 xrefs (both READ/DATA from the sole reader @ 0x2D669), zero writers -> const confirmed. Ghidra data plate was null; created a concise plate via run_script_inline setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...) and saved program. src comment block (uitab.c lines 143-158) already precise/accurate/ASCII-clean -> kept, no Edit to uitab.c. Bytes at +16 onward belong to the adjacent twin table_b @ 0x526EA, not part of this 16-byte table.
